title: Low-temperature phosphidation synthesis of flower-like Ru-CoVO-P polymetallic catalyst for enhanced overall water splitting in alkaline seawater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32732-32745
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04957A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yongqi Tian, Yufang Yang, Dongyan Zhong, Shuangshuang Zhang, Boyao Zhang, Xin Li, Huiya Zhou, Rong-Da Zhao, Lihua Miao
A flower-like Ru-CoVO-P catalyst composed of ultrathin nanosheets shows excellent overall water splitting performance with low overpotentials of 88.7 mV (HER) and 248.3 mV (OER) at 10 mA cm−2 in alkali.
